title: LinkedIn Profile Input
description: Pull public profile facts from any LinkedIn member URL without a cookie or login. Paste profile URLs and run.

profileUrls.title: Profile URLs
profileUrls.description: List of LinkedIn member URLs whose public profile facts you want to scrape. Examples: 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates', 'https://www.linkedin.com/in/satyanadella'. Slug or full URL both accepted.

includeExperience.title: Include experience
includeExperience.description: Pull the top experience items LinkedIn shows publicly. Each item ships with title, company, employment dates, and location when available.

includeEducation.title: Include education
includeEducation.description: Pull the top education entries LinkedIn shows publicly. Each entry ships with school, degree, field, and date range when available.

includeSkills.title: Include skills
includeSkills.description: Pull the top skills LinkedIn shows publicly on the profile.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of profiles processed in parallel. Higher concurrency runs faster but increases proxy and detection risk. Six is a safe default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for LinkedIn at any meaningful volume.
